public_health_question.v: How has the WHO African Region progressed in transitioning vaccine-preventable disease surveillance from Epi Info to DHIS2, and what challenges remain?

ev.q: This report describes the phased transition from Epi Info to DHIS2 IDSR and case-based surveillance packages in WHO African Region countries during 2019–2023
Migration from Epi Info to District Health Information Software 2 for Vaccine-Preventable Disease Surveillance
Activities include training, technical assistance, and ongoing monitoring to ensure successful data integration with the regional platform.
